fields.description: A group that will be fetched from OIDC token.
fields.label: Group

fields.description: An ERPNext module profile to be applied if the corresponding group exists in the OIDC token. A row left empty - as "Fetch Groups From Provider" leaves the rows it imports - is ignored at login: it neither applies anything nor counts as a match.
fields.label: Module Profile

fields.description: Lower numbers take precedence when a user matches more than one row. Relevant on Frappe versions that store a single Module Profile per user, where only the highest-priority match is assigned.
fields.label: Priority
